items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Rick, yeah, what Rick was doing and sometimes he’d play like an inflection of a flatted something... But that spontaneity it kept it fresh. So I was just responding to — what was the pianist— Rick.

ctx.x: Rick, yeah, what Rick was doing and sometimes he’d play like an inflection of a flatted something, and then it would make you — it was like I hope this works, you know. But that spontaneity it kept it fresh. That’s why this sounds so fresh.
Well it was a good experience.
